profile_sync_desc: Manage your vault identity and sync status.
disconnect_confirm_desc: This will stop cloud sync and remove the server connection. Your local data stays intact and the vault remains unlocked. You can reconnect anytime.
sync_method_desc: Choose how to sync your data. Both methods use end-to-end encryption.
sync_server_desc: Sync via self-hosted HTTP server. Real-time incremental.
security_desc: Manage local encryption and data storage.
lock_vault_desc: Clear keys from memory and return to the lock screen.
wipe_data_desc: Permanently delete local database and disconnect.
switch_warning: You are currently connected to {{url}}. Switching will upload your local encrypted data to the new server.
connect_info: Register your local account on the server to enable E2E encrypted cloud sync.
wipe_confirm_desc: This will permanently delete your local database, encryption keys, and log you out. This action cannot be undone.
webdav_card_desc: Sync via WebDAV services like Nutstore, Nextcloud.
webdav_info: Sync encrypted data to cloud storage via WebDAV. Supports Nutstore, Nextcloud, Synology NAS, etc. Data is encrypted locally before upload; the server cannot decrypt it.
about_desc: Check for app updates and version info.
shortcuts_desc: Available keyboard shortcuts and interactions in the app.
accent_color_desc: Choose the accent color used throughout the app.
terminal_color_link_desc: Terminal color scheme follows the UI accent color.
keyword_highlight_desc: Highlight keywords like ERROR, WARN, INFO in terminal output.
terminal_features_desc: Enable or disable terminal-related features as needed.
broadcast_desc: Shows a broadcast button when enabled. Click to enter broadcast mode where commands typed in one terminal are sent to all connected terminals simultaneously.
tab_color_desc: Right-click a tab to assign a color when enabled. Use colors to distinguish different hosts.
agent_forwarding_info: SSH Agent forwarding and proxy settings are configured per-host in the "Advanced" section of the host edit form.
session_log_desc: Write terminal session output to local disk for post-mortem troubleshooting.
session_log_enable_desc: When enabled, the full output of terminal sessions is saved to local log files.
session_log_retention_desc: Logs older than the retention period are deleted on startup.
session_log_warning: Session logs record everything in the terminal in plain text, including any passwords, tokens, and connection strings you type. Enable only when you actually need to troubleshoot, and keep the log files safe.
known_hosts_desc: Server key fingerprints pinned on first connection to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks. After a server key change, remove the old entry here before reconnecting.
known_hosts_remove_desc: This removes the pinned key for {{address}}. Only remove it if you are sure the server key change is legitimate (e.g. a server reinstall); the next connection will pin the new key.
conflict_desc: The following items were modified on more than one device at the same time. Choose the version to keep — the other one will be discarded.
conflict_banner_message: {{count}} sync conflict(s) detected — choose which version to keep.
